svg.title: Four ways to test review summaries, and the weakness of each
svg.desc: A diagram of the method in the article. A true A/B test needs a review summary switch, which the help page does not list. Four observational designs are shown instead: before and after with a marker, matched campaigns, GA4 landing page and quality checks, and support signals. Each has a stated weakness. Source: article text, citing Google Ads Help pages 18760807 and 6261395.
svg.text: FIGURE 2 · HOW TO TEST WITHOUT A SWITCH
No control to flip, so every design is a hint, not proof.
Can you switch review summaries off for a control group?
As far as the help page shows, no setting exists. A custom experiment needs a setting to change.

g.text: Compare CTR, conversion rate and cost
per conversion for 4 to 6 weeks each side
of the date summaries first appear.
Compare similar pairs, such as brand
against brand in two regions, where
summaries show on one and not the other.
and revenue per session by campaign,
mentions of claims you never made.
Seasonality and Google changes share the window.
Google chooses where to show it, so it is biased.
Shows who clicked, not why they clicked.
